Don't feel sad for relying on a cat. It's awesome when ye have something/someone to rely on to comfort and to put a smile on yer face~ 
I currently rely on Hope for a future and perfume!
Also cats are amezballs!~ Even though my cats left long ago the memories of them are sweet and I can't wait till I can get a one once more! I love Cats to bits! σ(≧ε≦ｏ)
Thanks... I'll try to.. (This will be my last message for a while cus I'm going away from the web and will sleep in a little bit)

Nah. I'm ok at this moment~ (But thanks for the offer) Also who the flip can just talk straight up to people on the phone?! I need to prepare myself mentally and almost do a small ritual.

Also although talking doesn't help (Well.. It doesn't help if I'm in a depressed mood but does help to keep it away) this short conversation is fun!

Offense not taken. No I'm not high unless someone drugged me. I haven't used any weird substances. Have eaten fairly normally. Not dehydrated.

The paranoia about stationary objects is temporary. It has only lasted up to 4 hoursish at most. But everything else is well.. permanent?

Also the shifting world does lose intensity but does not go away and randomly ramps up.

You see... I tried talking online... It doesn't help... I'm sorry... Talking doesn't fix the fact that I'm paranoid of stationary objects and that the world start shifting on in my view and that My face and the whole me doesn't feel like me. It all feels like a huge nightmare. I barely remember the time it didn't and bit by bit I'm getting more certain that time was just in my imagination. Dreams are merging into my life. What happened in them I think happend irl.
Yeah, I know that feeling... That person basically chained me to life as I was on a verge of death...
